multi_entity_note: Single point-of-sale receipt for one purchase transaction with one merchant and one payment.

receipt.subtotal_price.rationale: The amount under "Sub Tofal" (OCR of Sub Total) is 156000; the other 156000 occurrences are item price lines and the cash tendered.

receipt.discount_price.rationale: No discount is printed; "Rp. 0" is the change (Kembalian).
